instructions: Leave Sihlpost/HB using the public pedestrian crossings onto the station-side pavement. Follow the pavement north towards Europaplatz, then the public square to the side entrance of Gleis 3. Stay at street level. This route is only for Gleis 3; do not cross railway tracks or use the underground passages for another platform.
